mapper.select: /* BaseinfoMapper.selectCmpnyInfo */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCm , A.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_CMPNY A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}

/* BaseinfoMapper."selectWebMenuList" */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , B.MENU_M_ID AS menuMId , B.MENU_D_ID AS path , B.MENU_D_ID AS name , B.MENU_VIEW AS view , B.MENU_NM AS title FROM TB_USER A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.AUTH_CD , B.MENU_M_ID , A.MENU_D_ID , B.MENU_VIEW , B.MENU_NM FROM TB_SYST_AUTH_MENU A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.MENU_M_ID , B.MENU_D_ID , B.MENU_VIEW , B.MENU_NM , A.USE_YN FROM TB_SYST_MENU_M A INNER JOIN TB_SYST_MENU_D B ON ( A.MENU_M_ID = B.MENU_M_ID AND A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN ) WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.MENU_IDX, B.MENU_IDX ) B ON ( A.MENU_D_ID = B.MENU_D_ID AND A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN ) ) B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.AUTH_CD = B.AUTH_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd}

/* BaseinfoMapper."selectAppMenuList" */ SELECT A.MENU_M_ID AS menuMId , B.MENU_D_ID AS path , B.MENU_D_ID AS name , B.MENU_VIEW AS view , B.MENU_NM AS title FROM TB_SYST_MENU_M A INNER JOIN TB_SYST_MENU_D B ON ( A.MENU_M_ID = B.MENU_M_ID AND A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN ) WHERE A.MENU_SRC = '002' /* APP MENU TYPE */ AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* BaseinfoMapper."selectMenuList" */ SELECT B.MENU_M_ID AS keyId , CONCAT(B.MENU_M_ID, '_',B.MENU_SUB_IDX) AS id , B.TOP_MENU_NM AS topMenuNm , B.SIDE_MENU_NM AS sideMenu , B.MENU_D_ID AS route , B.BTN_SRCH AS btnSrch , B.BTN_NEW AS btnNew , B.BTN_DELT AS btnDelt , B.BTN_SAVE AS btnSave , B.BTN_EXCL AS btnExcl , B.MENU_IDX AS menuIdx , B.MENU_SUB_IDX AS menuSubIdx FROM TB_USER A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.AUTH_CD , B.MENU_M_ID , A.MENU_D_ID , B.MENU_VIEW , B.TOP_MENU_NM , B.SIDE_MENU_NM , A.BTN_SRCH , A.BTN_NEW , A.BTN_DELT , A.BTN_SAVE , A.BTN_EXCL , B.MENU_IDX , B.MENU_SUB_IDX FROM TB_SYST_AUTH_MENU A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.MENU_M_ID , A.MENU_NM AS TOP_MENU_NM , B.MENU_D_ID , B.MENU_VIEW , B.MENU_NM AS SIDE_MENU_NM , A.USE_YN , A.MENU_IDX , B.MENU_IDX AS MENU_SUB_IDX FROM TB_SYST_MENU_M A INNER JOIN TB_SYST_MENU_D B ON ( A.MENU_M_ID = B.MENU_M_ID AND A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN ) WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MENU_SRC = #{menuSrc} ORDER BY A.MENU_IDX, B.MENU_IDX ) B ON ( A.MENU_D_ID = B.MENU_D_ID AND A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN ) ) B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.AUTH_CD = B.AUTH_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.MENU_IDX, B.MENU_SUB_IDX

/* BaseinfoMapper.selectSmsVerifiedSmsId */ SELECT S.SMS_ID FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.MBL_NO_HMAC = S.MBL_NO_HMAC WHERE 1=1 AND U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND S.VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND S.UPDATE_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY S.UPDATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* BaseinfoMapper.consumeSmsAuth */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET VERIFIED_YN = 'C' , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND SMS_ID = #{smsId} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* BaseinfoMapper."selectTermsDetailInfo" */ SELECT A.TERMS_ID AS termsId , A.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion , A.REQUIRED_YN AS requiredYn , A.TERMS_CONTENT AS termsContent , A.STR_DATE AS strDate , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.TERMS_DESC AS termsDesc , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , A.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM TB_TERMS A WHERE A.TERMS_ID = #{termsId}
